title: PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , STATUTORY EXEMPTION FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA), HOUSING ELEMENT ENVIRONMENTAL…
text:
[Council File 21-1230-S6]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , STATUTORY EXEMPTION FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA), HOUSING ELEMENT ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT (EIR) NO. ENV-2020-6762 (STATE CLEARINGHOUSE NO. 2021010130), AND ADDENDA 1 AND 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1 AND ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2), AND RELATED CEQA FINDINGS relative to Housing Element Sites and Minimum Density Amendment and Lower Income Sites proposed ordinances amending Chapters 1 and 1A of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC) to address technical clarification and corrections to codify statutory requirements of state housing element law, and to codify the Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites consistent with Housing Element law.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. FIND, based on the whole of the administrative record in the independent judgment of the decision maker, that the proposed Project is statutorily exempt under CEQA pursuant to the California Public Resources Code Section 21080.085(a); and FIND that the Project was assessed in the Housing Element
Environmental Impact Report (EIR) NO. ENV-2020-6762 (SCH No. 2021010130) certified on November 29, 2021, and Addenda 1 and 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1 and ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2), and pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Sections 15162 and 15164, no subsequent EIR is required.
2. ADOPT the FINDINGS of the Los Angeles City Planning Commission (LACPC) as the Findings of Council.
3. APPROVE, pursuant to Charter Section 558(b)(3) of the City Charter, and Section 13B.1.3 of Chapter 1A of the LAMC, the proposed Housing Element Sites and Minimum Density Amendment Ordinance, to amend the Zoning Code including amendments to Chapter 1 and 1A of the LAMC, including revisions to sections 16.70, 12.22 A.37, 12.22 A.38, and 12.22 A.39 of Chapter 1 and any related Code sections of Chapter 1 and Sections 1.5.1, 1.5.13, 1.5.14, 1.5.15, 4C.15.2, 4C.15.4, 6B.2, 6C.2.1, 9.2.1, 9.2.2, 9.2.3, 9.2.4, 9.2.5, 9.2.6, and 14.3 of Chapter 1A and any related Code sections of Chapter 1A.
4. APPROVE, pursuant to Charter Section 558(b)(3) of the City Charter the Lower Income Sites Ordinance.
5. REQUEST the City Attorney to prepare and present the two draft ordinances.
Applicant: City of Los Angeles Case No. CPC-2026-4893-CA
Environmental Nos. ENV-2026-4894-SE, ENV-2020-6762-EIR, ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1, ENV-2020-6762-EIR- ADD2
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the LACPC. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
summary: Citywide zoning code changes to meet state housing law, including clarifying rules for Housing Element sites, letting projects use abutting sites, and updating the inventory of lower-income rezoning sites.

details.action: code amendment and Housing Element sites ordinance
